designationHistory.indexText: The federal government bought refuge easements on Wild Rice Lake in 1934 as a water and wildlife conservation project, reserving the right to impound water and keep a no-hunting area for migratory birds.
designationHistory.note: Pass A found only the 2000 Tewaukon CCP, which says easements on Lake Elsie, Wild Rice and Storm Lake were purchased in 1934; it gives no establishing order or date. Pass B found no executive order or proclamation for this refuge in the National Archives disposition tables (1937-1952) or the American Presidency Project. Needs an independent record of the easement or designation.

sources.name: FWS, Tewaukon National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (2000), "Tewaukon Complex Easement Refuges"
